episodes.title: THE VOID CLOSED THE LOOP
episodes.caption:
We thought the distortion was pulling light inward.

It wasn't.

The same path curved back into itself.
Two arcs.
One continuous bend.

Space had closed the loop.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-001
episodes.pinned_comment:
GEOMETRY NOTE:

Both arcs contain the same background star pattern.

No exit point has been identified.

The path appears continuous.

episodes.title: THE EMPTY CENTER
episodes.caption:
At first, the debris looked like an impact field.

Then we tracked the center.

Nothing was there.
Nothing crossed it.

Every rock curved around the same absence.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-002
episodes.pinned_comment:
DEBRIS NOTE:

No central body has been detected.

Multiple trajectories bend before reaching the center.

The empty region remained fixed.

episodes.title: EARTH WAS INSIDE THE BEND
episodes.caption:
The bright paths were not moving toward Earth.

Earth was already inside them.

They curved around the planet and Moon without contact.

Whatever was bending the path extended beyond the frame.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-003
episodes.pinned_comment:
LENSING NOTE:

Earth and the Moon remained structurally unchanged.

Only the surrounding paths curved.

The source of the distortion is outside the visible frame.

episodes.title: THE AURORA WENT UP
episodes.caption:
Auroras should follow the atmosphere.

These didn't.

The light rose away from Earth in narrow columns.

Then every column twisted toward the same dark point.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-004
episodes.pinned_comment:
ATMOSPHERIC NOTE:

The luminous columns remained attached to Earth's upper atmosphere.

Their upper ends converged toward one region of space.

No source was visible there.

episodes.title: EVERY SATELLITE TURNED AT ONCE
episodes.caption:
There were hundreds of objects around Earth.

Different altitudes.
Different trajectories.

Then their paths began curving toward one dark region behind the planet.

It wasn't a collision.

It looked coordinated.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-005
episodes.pinned_comment:
ORBITAL NOTE:

The objects changed direction at different distances from Earth.

Their correction vectors converge on the same region.

No visible mass has been confirmed there.

episodes.title: IT WAS ALREADY BEHIND EARTH
episodes.caption:
We thought the structure was approaching Earth.

Then the horizon moved past it.

It had already been there.

One arch rose into view.
Then another.

We never saw where the rest of it ended.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-006
episodes.pinned_comment:
HORIZON NOTE:

The structure remained behind Earth throughout the observation.

Only more of its upper geometry became visible.

Its full scale is still unknown.

episodes.title: THE CONSTELLATION HAD A BODY
episodes.caption:
We mapped the stars first.

The pattern was familiar.

What changed was the darkness beneath them.

A shape resolved under the constellation.

And it was facing the planet.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-007
episodes.pinned_comment:
STARFIELD NOTE:

The star positions did not change.

The dark structure became visible without disturbing the pattern above it.

Its distance cannot be measured from this frame.

episodes.title: FOUR SIGNALS MET AT EARTH
episodes.caption:
One line appeared.

Then three more.

They did not pass through Earth.

They ended there.

Four directions.
One intersection.

Our planet was at the center.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-008
episodes.pinned_comment:
SIGNAL GEOMETRY NOTE:

All four paths remained symmetrical around Earth.

No continuation was detected beyond the planet.

The convergence was stable.

episodes.title: THE ASTEROIDS LEFT A CORRIDOR
episodes.caption:
The field looked random until we mapped the gaps.

Thousands of rocks.

One clear path through the middle.

Nothing was moving through it.

The corridor was already there.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-009
episodes.pinned_comment:
DEBRIS NOTE:

The central corridor remains unusually clear across the observed depth.

Nearby rocks do not cross it.

No object has been detected inside the path.

episodes.title: THEY MET AT THE MOON
episodes.caption:
We thought the Moon was being attacked.

Then both structures stopped.

Two separate forms reached for the same object.

Their hands met around it.

Neither reacted to Earth.

Whatever this was, we were outside the exchange.

COLOSSUS SIGNAL // SS2-010
episodes.pinned_comment:
CONTACT NOTE:

Two independent structures reached the same object from opposite directions.

Both stopped at contact.

Earth remained outside the interaction.
